          Scenes

            Opens Universal VTT maps (.dd2vtt, .uvtt, .df2vtt) exported from Dungeondraft, Dungeon Alchemist, DungeonFog and others, with their walls, doors and lights.

            Scene music

            No music for this scene.

            Each scene keeps its own track, and switching scenes switches the music. It loops until you pause it.

            Save and open

            Saves every scene, map, token, note and fog state into one .json file. Open it on any device to pick up where you left off. Opening a file replaces what's here, so save first if you need it.

            Handouts

              Pick a layout and a style, then edit any of the text. Show opens a handout full screen (and on the player screen). Copy an existing handout to reuse it as a template. Handouts belong to the whole table, not one scene.

              Fog and lighting

              Walls stop creatures from being dragged through them. Tick the box above, or hold Shift while dropping, to move a creature through anyway. With lighting on, creatures with vision see until a wall blocks the view, and places they have seen stay dimly revealed.

              Scene

              Pinch or scroll to zoom. Drag empty space to pan. Keys: M move, R measure, T area, D draw, F fog, W walls, N note, P ping, Ctrl+Z undo, Delete removes the selected token.
